_doc: Business domain taxonomy: news categories and research tags (NBER-style fields).

news_categories.Markets: Stocks, bonds, currencies and commodities moves with a clear cause
news_categories.Central Banks & Rates: Fed, Bank of Canada, ECB and other rate decisions and guidance
news_categories.Economy & Data: Inflation, jobs, GDP, spending and other macro releases
news_categories.Deals & M&A: Mergers, acquisitions, takeovers and large investments
news_categories.Earnings & Companies: Results, guidance, strategy and leadership at major companies
news_categories.Trade & Policy: Tariffs, sanctions, regulation, antitrust and fiscal policy
news_categories.Labor & Workplace: Layoffs, hiring, wages, unions and work arrangements
news_categories.Banking & Finance: Banks, credit, private markets, insurance and crypto
news_categories.Energy & Commodities: Oil, gas, power, metals and agricultural markets
news_categories.Tech & AI Business: Business side of technology: AI spending, chips, platforms
news_categories.Consumer & Retail: Consumer demand, retail, travel and brands
news_categories.Startups & VC: Funding rounds, IPOs and venture markets

Labor markets.desc: Employment, wages, labor supply and demand

Innovation & technology.desc: R&D, patents, AI and automation in firms

International trade.desc: Trade flows, tariffs, global value chains

Regulation.desc: Rules and their effects on markets
